tasks.title: Declarative Runbook Schema & Repository Scaffold
tasks.description: Design and implement the YAML runbook schema (triggers, steps, rollback commands, approval requirements), scaffold the runbooks git repository, and implement the runbook registry API with semantic versioning.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook YAML schema is published as a JSON Schema document
Runbook repository initialized with validation CI pipeline
Runbook registry API returns all versioned runbooks with metadata
Semantic version tags auto-applied on commit

tasks.title: GitOps Remediation PR Automation Engine
tasks.description: Build the engine that listens for incident-triggered remediation requests, automatically creates GitOps PRs with incident ID, severity, runbook reference, and targets the correct environment branch. Implement PR lifecycle monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: Remediation PR auto-created when remediation workflow is triggered
PR includes incident ID, severity, and runbook reference in description
PR targets correct environment branch per policy
CI checks (syntax, policy-as-code) execute automatically on PR
PR status published as event for downstream dashboards

tasks.title: Audit Trail & One-Click Rollback (Git History)
tasks.description: Implement the git-history based audit trail for all remediation actions. Build one-click revert PR generation, drift verification after rollback, and the audit query API.
acceptance_criteria: Complete git history queryable per incident: who, what, when, rollback hash
One-click revert PR generation for any merged remediation PR
Revert PR is itself recorded as auditable event
Drift verification runs after rollback and publishes result event

tasks.title: Policy-as-Code Approval Gate Engine
tasks.description: Implement the policy engine that evaluates remediation PRs against policy-as-code rules stored in git. Support severity-based, service-based, and environment-based approval gates with CAB escalation.
acceptance_criteria: Policy rules evaluated automatically on PR creation
PR tagged with required approvers based on severity, service, environment
Policy violations block the merge with detailed guidance
Policy-as-code rules stored alongside runbooks in git
Approval gate status published as event (approved/blocked/escalated)

tasks.title: Multi-Cloud Cost Ingestion & Anomaly Detection Pipeline
tasks.description: Build the cost telemetry ingestion pipeline for AWS, GCP, and Azure with per-region data stores. Implement dynamic threshold anomaly detection (3σ from 7-day trailing baseline) with 1-hour deduplication window.
acceptance_criteria: Cost metrics ingested from all three cloud providers per region
Dynamic threshold anomaly detection (3σ from 7-day baseline)
Anomaly event includes provider, region, service, delta, projected impact
Anomaly tagged with data residency zone (EU data never leaves EU)
Duplicate anomalies suppressed within 1-hour window

tasks.title: Automated FinOps Optimization Engine with ROI Scoring
tasks.description: Implement the cost optimization recommendation engine that analyzes cost data across all providers and regions, generates recommendations sorted by ROI score, and produces GitOps remediation PR templates.
acceptance_criteria: Optimization recommendations sorted by projected ROI (highest first)
Each recommendation includes resource, current cost, savings, complexity, PR template
EU recommendations never suggest moving data to US
Debounce: max 1 recommendation per resource per 24h
Recommendations publishable as GitOps PR templates

tasks.title: Showback/Show-Charge Reporting Engine (Multi-Cloud)
tasks.description: Build the monthly showback/show-charge report engine that aggregates cost by SRE team, service, provider, and region. Includes trend analysis, next-month projections, and CSV/PDF export with data residency enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Monthly showback report per team with full provider/region/service breakdown
Show-charge report for internal chargeback with same breakdown
EU cost data stored only in EU databases
Reports available via API and downloadable as CSV/PDF
Next-month cost projections based on current run-rate

tasks.title: Cost vs. Reliability Trade-off Dashboard
tasks.description: Implement the interactive scatter-plot dashboard comparing monthly cost vs. SLO attainment per service, with provider coloring, incident sizing, and a draggable reliability target slider showing projected cost impact.
acceptance_criteria: Scatter plot: cost (x-axis) vs SLO attainment (y-axis) per service
Points colored by provider, sized by incident count
Draggable reliability target slider updates projected cost impact
EU services show only EU cost data
Cross-region eventual consistency with max 5 min lag

tasks.title: AI-Powered Incident Triage Agent (Severity & Ownership)
tasks.description: Build the AI triage agent that classifies incoming incidents by severity (P0-P4) and assigns ownership based on historical patterns and service topology, with confidence scoring and human review flagging.
acceptance_criteria: Incident classified with severity (P0-P4) and confidence score
Ownership assigned to SRE team/service based on patterns
Structured data extracted: service, error signature, time range, impact
Classification flagged for review if confidence < 80%
Classification event published with full payload including confidence score

tasks.title: Automated Root Cause Analysis Engine
tasks.description: Implement the RCA engine that analyzes logs, metrics, traces, and recent changes to produce ranked root cause suggestions with causal chains and links to similar past incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Ranked list of root causes with supporting evidence for each
Each RCA suggestion includes causal chain, related git changes, similar incident link
RCA for EU incidents only uses EU data sources
Top RCA suggestion attached to incident record

tasks.title: Self-Healing Runbook Execution Agent
tasks.description: Build the autonomous agent that matches incidents to runbooks with high confidence, triggers GitOps remediation PRs, monitors execution, auto-resolves on success, and escalates with logs on failure. P0 incidents require human approval.
acceptance_criteria: Agent matches incident to runbook with confidence >90%
GitOps remediation PR created via TASK-002 when match found
PR lifecycle monitored: CI, approval, merge
Execution status reported to incident timeline
Success → auto-resolve; Failure → escalate with full logs
P0 incidents blocked without explicit human approval

tasks.title: Escalation Engine with Human-in-the-Loop & Feedback Loop
tasks.description: Implement the escalation engine that pages on-call engineers (PagerDuty/Opsgenie), manages multi-tier escalation with 5-min acknowledgment timeout, and captures human feedback for the continuous learning loop.
acceptance_criteria: Engine pages on-call engineer with full incident context and agent summary
5-min acknowledgment timeout escalates to next tier
Full escalation path recorded in immutable audit trail
Human feedback (correct classification/runbook) captured for model improvement
Feedback consumed by continuous learning loop

tasks.title: Local-First SRE Dashboard with Offline Store
tasks.description: Build the local-first SRE dashboard architecture using IndexedDB/SQLite for offline operation. All reads work offline; writes queue locally with clear online/offline status indicators, last sync timestamp, and pending changes count. Data residency enforced per engineer region.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard loads from local store with cloud sync as background
All read operations work offline (incidents, runbooks, topology)
Write operations queued locally when offline
UI shows online/offline status, last sync, pending changes
EU engineer's local store only contains EU-authorized data

tasks.title: CRDT-Based Local-First Runbook Authoring & Versioning
tasks.description: Implement CRDT-based local runbook editing with full offline version history, diff viewing against last synced cloud version, and automatic PR creation on sync restore. Concurrent edit merging via CRDT resolution rules.
acceptance_criteria: Changes stored locally using CRDTs for conflict-free data types
Local version history maintained without network
Diffs viewable between local and last synced cloud version
Connectivity restored → local changes synced as Git PR
Concurrent edits merged using CRDT resolution rules

tasks.title: P2P Sync Between SRE Team Member Workspaces
tasks.description: Build the P2P sync layer that directly synchronizes incident timeline and runbook changes between SRE engineers in the same data residency zone. Uses CRDT merge with sub-second latency. Cross-zone sync is blocked by compliance.
acceptance_criteria: P2P sync operates within same data residency zone only (EU↔EU, US↔US)
CRDT merge: LWW for scalars, merge for arrays
Sub-second sync latency for same-region P2P connections
Users see which team members are in the same workspace session
Cross-zone sync (EU↔US) blocked with violation event

tasks.title: Progressive Cloud Sync Engine with Conflict Resolution
tasks.description: Implement the progressive sync engine that prioritizes upload order (incident timeline → runbook edits → dashboard state) on connectivity restore, handles data-residency-aware endpoints, surfaces sync conflicts, and compacts the CRDT log after full sync.
acceptance_criteria: Sync priority: incident timeline first, runbook edits second, dashboard state last
Data-residency-aware endpoints: EU changes → EU cloud, US → US
Per-file sync progress indicators visible in UI
Sync conflicts surfaced for manual resolution
CRDT log compacted after full sync completes
